message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "kimgio_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 44, "var": "data", "code": "QBuffer b; b.setData((const char *)data, size);", "note": "Attacker-controlled TGA bytes are placed into a QBuffer as the input device."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "TGAHandler::read", "line": 355, "var": "tga", "code": "QDataStream s(device()); s >> tga;", "note": "The 18-byte TGA header is parsed: image_type=10 (RLE_RGB), width=1, height=1, pixel_size=16."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 311, "var": "tga", "code": "if (!IsSupported(tga)) return false;", "note": "Header passes IsSupported: RLE_RGB with colormap_type=0, nonzero dimensions, pixel_size=16."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 178, "var": "size", "code": "qint64 size = qint64(tga.width) * qint64(tga.height) * pixel_size;", "note": "size = 1*1*2 = 2 bytes of pixel data expected."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 225, "var": "image", "code": "uchar *const image = reinterpret_cast<uchar*>(malloc(size));", "note": "2-byte image buffer allocated via malloc; contents are uninitialized."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 238, "var": "c", "code": "uchar c; s >> c;", "note": "RLE packet header byte 0x80 is read; count = (0x80 & 0x7f) + 1 = 1."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 251, "var": "pixel", "code": "char pixel[8]; s.readRawData(pixel, pixel_size);", "note": "readRawData(pixel, 2) is called but the stream is at end (0 bytes remain), so it returns 0 and pixel[0..1] remain uninitialized."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 253, "var": "dst", "code": "memcpy(dst, pixel, pixel_size);", "note": "2 uninitialized bytes from pixel are copied into the image buffer, propagating uninitialized data."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 313, "var": "c", "code": "Color555 c = *reinterpret_cast<Color555 *>(src);", "note": "Reads 2 uninitialized bytes as a Color555 struct; the bitfield extraction of c.r, c.g, c.b reads uninitialized memory, triggering MSAN Use-of-uninitialized-value."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"` executed with exit code 0.
